title: CT Core
description: Cover traffic: bursts, costs, sessions and health across all CT nodes.

panels.title: Healthy CT nodes
panels.description: Nodes whose hoprd reports connected (ct_node_health = 1) out of all selected nodes.

panels.title: Safe stake
panels.description: wxHOPR in the Safes of the selected nodes, each Safe counted once.

panels.title: Cost / day (est.)
panels.description: Expected wxHOPR paid for echoed burst packets over the last 24h, summed over nodes.

panels.title: Runway (est.)
panels.description: Safe stake divided by the last-24h relay cost.

panels.title: Month-to-date cost
panels.description: Expected wxHOPR paid since the start of the UTC month, summed over nodes.

panels.title: Projected max monthly cost
panels.description: Monthly cost if every relayer echoed 100% of the packets, from each node's current round plan.

panels.title: Echo rate
panels.description: Echoed / sent burst packets over the dashboard time range.

panels.title: Nodes
panels.description: Current state of each CT node.

panels.title: Echo rate
panels.description: Echoed / sent burst packets per node.

panels.title: Bursts scheduled / min
panels.description: queued: burst handed to the workers. skipped_ineligible: relayer dropped out of eligibility mid-round.

panels.title: Relay cost / hour
panels.description: Expected wxHOPR paid for echoed packets (2 tickets per echoed packet).

panels.title: Lowest echo rate relayers
panels.description: Relayers with the lowest echoed / sent ratio over the time range, across the selected nodes.

panels.title: Round concurrency
panels.description: Average number of bursts running at once in the current round.

panels.title: Network
panels.description: Network-wide values, identical on every node: max over nodes.

panels.title: Eligible relayers
panels.description: Should match across nodes; a diverging line means a node has a stale view.
